# Atlas tokens (semantic)

Use these in app code. Never a hex, rgb, oklch or px literal, and never a primitive ramp (`--atlas-color-*`) — those exist only to define the semantic layer. All tokens flip automatically under `data-theme="dark"`.

`background` · `background-subtle` · `background-muted`
`surface` · `surface-raised` · `surface-overlay`
`foreground` · `foreground-muted` · `foreground-subtle` · `foreground-disabled` · `foreground-on-brand`
`border` · `border-strong` · `border-subtle`

## Motion
`duration-instant` 0ms · `duration-fast` 120ms · `duration-base` 200ms · `duration-slow` 320ms
`easing-linear` cubic-bezier(0, 0, 1, 1) · `easing-standard` cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) · `easing-emphasized` cubic-bezier(0.3, 0, 0, 1) · `easing-exit` cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1)
Wrap every transition in `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` and switch it off.
